decisions.title: Go for agent and relay core
decisions.decision: Use Go for the device agent and relay-server core.
decisions.rationale: Single-binary cross-platform distribution, straightforward concurrency, and a small runtime dependency surface.

decisions.title: Structured capabilities before raw shell
decisions.decision: Structured capabilities are the default execution interface; raw shell is denied by default.
decisions.rationale: Reduce prompt-injection blast radius and keep local policy explicit.

decisions.title: Outbound-only device networking
decisions.decision: Normal device connectivity originates outbound from the user PC.
decisions.rationale: Avoid exposing inbound services on user machines and work across NAT and firewalls.

decisions.title: Go 1.24 minimum for traversal-resistant filesystem execution
decisions.decision: Raise the project minimum to Go 1.24 and use os.Root for filesystem executor operations.
decisions.rationale: The project is new and security-sensitive; os.Root provides traversal-resistant operations without a check-then-use authorization race.

decisions.title: Remote payload cannot grant privileged approval
decisions.decision: CapabilityRequest contains no trusted approval boolean or token in Phase 1; privileged capabilities stop at APPROVAL_REQUIRED.
decisions.rationale: An LLM or compromised relay must not self-authorize mutation process execution or network clone.

decisions.title: Terminal-first Phase 4 control surface
decisions.decision: Close Phase 4 on the secure runnable outbound agent plus max-chat terminal client; move graphical multi-device chat UI/device selector to Phase 5.
decisions.rationale: The terminal surface proves the cryptographic controller/provider/tool path with a smaller attack surface and no new web auth/session layer. Graphical multi-device UI remains explicitly unproven rather than being conflated with source-complete terminal control.
